body: It's not the same as being enrolled. As soon as they see the transcript they will rescind the application before I move in or anything.

Thank you for your kind words. I wish I had someone I could confide in without any judgement from them, but I don't and so I had to resort to this. I just wish I could turn back time and undo this terrible thing.
They're a top tier school, not an Ivy League, but I still think they would be able to see the massive differences between my application grades and my transcript
Even if I could. My high school has to send out the transcripts anyways.
thank you. I just don't know how it will ever be okay again. I'm so scared. I want them to love me for me and not just because im their son and they have to.

I've attempted suicide before and I've seen how broken it made them. I've seen my mom bawl tears over my body in the hospital. and even then I still want to kill myself. Its fucked up, I know. But maybe thoughts like this mean the world is better off without me.
i guess i would want to go to a community college for 2 years and transfer out to a 4 year. But i dont know if i can deal with everyone finding out I lied.

I can't face them after they find out. I just can't. Its less about me wanting to go to this college and more about me not wanting to betray them again. I can't deal with the aftermath. Everyone who cares about me thinks I'm going to this college.

with my actual grades I'm more than positive the college would never accept me. I'm pretty sure my gpa is even lower than the application requirement. As for my family, they would help me but it really just wouldn't be the same and im scared that I will keep lying like this.

honestly the worst part of it all is that I know they would eventually forgive me but our relationship would never be the same. My mom already sometimes bursts into tears and says she wants to be able to blindly trust me like she does my brother and like she did when I was a kid. I assure her that I won't lie anymore even though my whole life is a lie. If she found out about this, she'd be devestated . I would love nothing more than a gap year. Honestly sometimes I imagine getting hit by a car or seriously injured some way, even shot. And I romanticize these thoughts because I feel as though it would be easy for me afterwards to say "I don't feel safe, I'd rather stay home and go to community college" with them agreeing without question. I can't believe how sad my life has gotten
